name: hackshop
description: An open-source MCP server and website that maps a project idea to hackable, repurposable, or protocol-native hardware, returning 3-5 candidates with brick-risk ratings, firmware links, live eBay searches, step-by-step how-tos, and AI-generated architecture diagrams.

allowed_actions: Submit the demo form on / via the button tagged data-agent-action="propose-hardware" when the user asks for hardware proposals.
Follow outbound reference links (eBay searches, firmware repos, Hackaday, Reddit) for reading and research.
Install and query the hackshop-mcp MCP server for programmatic access.
disallowed_actions: Do not activate any control tagged data-agent-danger (e.g. "Clear all" on /inventory) without explicit user confirmation; these delete the user's saved inventory.
Do not loop or retry calls to /api/propose; it is rate limited to 5 requests/hour/IP.
Do not crawl or scrape /api/* routes; they are disallowed in robots.txt and back the UI only.
Do not attempt account creation, login, or checkout; this site has no accounts or payment flows.
Do not complete external purchases (eBay, manufacturer stores) on the user's behalf.
